jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Data Functional Analyst

Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq

• 
Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team

Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects

• 
Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts

• 
Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory)

• 
Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects

• 
Language skills

• 
Fluent English (written and spoken)

• 
Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration)

•
